verdict.summary: Round 3 finds the design record correct and complete as scoped. It remains explicit that nothing is implemented, rejects the unsound bare-origin approach with concrete WAC and ACP counterexamples, preserves shared-subject dependency edges until per-triple provenance hardening lands, requires fail-safe full-materialization fallback, and mandates non-vacuous differential and RED-then-GREEN tests before the risky index-patching phase. The unimplemented and unanalysed areas, including ODRL interaction, are disclosed as prerequisites rather than claimed solved. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, security, or prompt-injection issue is evident. With round 2 also having no findings, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
